title: Fix/62341 task log display
body:
Fixes task log display in the UI by wiring virtualization to the actual scroll container in `TaskLogContent`, so full logs are reachable when scrolling.

closes: #62341

Shows all logs in grid view:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/255078ac-71ba-40bc-b7e1-134fef2e9663

Shows all logs in graph view:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ea6a4313-e104-4f71-ae3b-2060ba7a95de
